purpose: Cartographic context for an authored story; not for area calculation or boundary decisions.
attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – British Columbia.

acquisition.pageOrder: Ascending OBJECTID; exact requested ID set checked on each page
acquisition.assembly: FeatureCollection in EPSG:3005; pages in ascending OBJECTID order; compact Python JSON serialization.

geometry.dissolve: Make valid if needed, discard non-area line/point residues, union by exact MAP_LABEL with ASCII whitespace removed.
geometry.displaySimplificationRule: Start at 750 m, then halve per code until the final display area differs by at most 5% from repaired, dissolved acquired geometry; this is cartographic QA only.
geometry.topology: GEOS topology-preserving simplification per dissolved code; valid-output precision reduction; all 222 emitted geometries are nonempty and valid. Shared boundaries between different codes are not an analytical coverage.

crosswalk.method: Exact BEC code match only; no aliases, successor aggregation or inferred assignments.

limitations: The original study does not publish its BEC v12 analysis geometry; v13.1 shapes are contextual only.
Revisions to BEC boundaries and definitions are not evidence of ecosystems physically moving over time.
The source deliberately extends across oceans, lakes and glaciers; no terrestrial mask was added to this display.
The map is generalized for regional viewing (maximum zoom 9), not local boundary interpretation.
Do not use the display or its cartographic diagnostics to recalculate the 2023 study areas or percentages.
Study units absent from v13.1 remain in the table; current codes without a study row have no historical percentage.
The Access Only official 1:250,000 generalized service is not redistributed; this derives from the separately openly licensed BEC Map.

cartographicDiagnostics.purpose: Geometry preparation checks only. These are not the study's protected areas or percentages.
cartographicDiagnostics.areaReference: Repaired, dissolved acquired geometry in EPSG:3005; includes the corporate overwater extensions.
